table.name: TLGNR_COMPANYCODE_BS
table.description: Represents a Company Code from SAP. In SAP, called BUKRS

column.name: COMPANYCODE_CD
column.description: A company code as known in SAP (BUKRS), e.g.: FR01, BG01

column.name: COMPANYCODE_NAME
column.description: Full name of the company which may be displayed in the application. Normally, only the code (companycode_cd) is used and displayed however.

column.name: REGION_CD
column.description: Country code of the comapde code of the orders' sales area. This field is only used

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
